Colorado Secretary of State now prosecutes Pueblo Democrats in bingo finance case it dismissed
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
Want your full news breakdown? Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**We’re LIVE from Rocky Mountain Voice Freedom Fest at the Douglas County Fairgrounds in Castle Rock** — and it’s already been an incredible day! From speakers and interviews to rodeo energy, behind-the-scenes moments, and thousands of freedom-loving Coloradans coming together, this is exactly what we hoped Freedom Fest would be.
If you can’t be here in person, follow along with us on social media all day today and tomorrow. We’ll be posting [live updates on X](), plus videos, interviews, and highlights across [Facebook](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Instagram](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [TikTok](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and [X](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Come join the fun from wherever you are — and if you’re nearby, there’s still time to be part of it!
🤠 **There's still time to join us tomorrow!** We still have room at Saturday's Freedom Fest Rodeo, and tickets are just **$45**. Whether you've been following along online or are looking for a fun family outing, we'd love to see you at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. Grab your rodeo tickets and come experience one of the biggest highlights of Freedom Fest!
🎟️ **[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, June 26, 2026.
– Team RMV

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado Secretary of State now prosecutes Pueblo Democrats in bingo finance case it dismissed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The Colorado Secretary of State’s office dismissed the complaint. Now, after a judge sent the case back, the state itself is the one prosecuting it.
On June 15, the office’s Elections Division filed its own complaint against the Pueblo County Democrat Party. The complaint alleges the Pueblo County Democrat Party failed to report contributions and expenditures tied to its affiliated Central Committee and its bingo-funded headquarters.
The filing advances a case Pueblo resident Jonathan Ambler spent nearly two years building: that the party financed operations through an affiliated nonprofit and its bingo operation without reporting that activity in state campaign finance filings.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Initiative 195 would raise taxes on Colorado’s top earners. A new report asks whether they’d stay.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Initiative 195 would scrap Colorado's flat 4.4% income tax in favor of six brackets topping out at 8.4% on income above $1 million — and the Common Sense Institute projects the fallout could include a net loss of 14 firms, roughly $200 million in corporate profit, and an estimated $186 million in personal income annually as high earners relocate to lower-tax states.
* The measure would also circumvent the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights, allowing the state to collect and spend up to $2.7 billion in new revenue outside TABOR's limits — a significant expansion of government power that critics like Advance Colorado's Michael Fields warn would "chase revenue out of the state" and hit pass-through small businesses especially hard.
* Colorado's own relocation tracker logged 27 companies that left or expanded elsewhere in 2025 alone — its highest single-year total — signaling that the state's tax and regulatory climate is already pushing businesses out the door before Initiative 195 has even reached the ballot.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | JUNE 26** _Today, many Americans across the political spectrum are uninformed and/or unfamiliar with the US Constitution and US legal code. Yet they want elections and election results to be fair and accurate. Confusion, division and conflict are common, often guided more by opinion or emotions, but not the truth or facts. Social or mainstream media will never be a substitute for primary research from reliable sources._ __
**[Colorado non-citizen households used welfare at a far higher rate than the U.S.-born.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 24** _Half of Colorado households headed by a non-citizen, regardless of legal status, either used a traditional welfare program or qualified for federal tax credits aimed at low-wage workers. That is the finding of a new national report the Center for Immigration Studies released June 11. It is built on five years of Census Bureau survey data, pooled to get state samples large enough to be meaningful._
____
**[Mike Davis changed the Supreme Court. Now he has Colorado officials in his sights.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JUNE 23** _On the morning Tina Peters walked out of a Colorado prison, Mike Davis was already filing paperwork. The referral went to the Department of Justice before the cameras left. It named four Colorado officials — Mesa County District Judge Matthew Barrett, Attorney General Phil Weiser, Mesa County District Attorney Dan Rubinstein, and Secretary of State Jena Griswold — and called on Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights Harmeet Dhillon to open a federal criminal investigation into the prosecution that put Peters away._**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

name: Justice Anita Earls
subject: North Carolina freedoms are under attack
body:
North Carolina’s rights are on the line.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260626-3.xVepbr&refcode=em20260626-1554&%3Bamount=5&t=1&akid=1554%2E1086043%2EgEzeHR)
Peter, this is NC Supreme Court Justice Anita Earls.
I have spent my career fighting to protect the rights of all North Carolinians and ensuring the law applies equally to everyone.
In my bid for re-election, I currently hold a narrow lead against my opponent, who has pushed for extreme partisan gerrymandering, restrictions on reproductive rights, and efforts to defund public education – all while loosening protections for victims and defending corporations.
The last thing North Carolina needs is another career politician bringing an extreme legislative agenda onto the bench. North Carolinians deserve justices who will uphold the law, protect constitutional rights and freedoms, and serve as a check on political overreach — not carry it out from the bench.
This race will shape the direction of the court for years to come. Our ability to defend voting rights, public education, reproductive freedom, and the separation of powers is on the line.

I’m honored to be your Democratic nominee for Nevada governor.
#
Peter,
This month, Nevada Democrats made me their nominee for governor.
I want to be honest with you about what I'm feeling right now: **grateful, fired up, and ready to work.**
[**If you’re ready to flip Nevada blue this November, then I’m humbly asking you to split a donation between Small Town PAC and our campaign today. This is a toss-up race, and we’re going to need every bit of support to win.**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=partner-ms-ford-em-small-town-pac.aPk-r1&amount=5&refcode=em20260626-797&t=2&akid=797%2E34582%2EeZ71Ja)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=partner-ms-ford-em-small-town-pac.aPk-r1&amount=5&refcode=20260626-797&t=3&akid=797%2E34582%2EeZ71Ja)**
This is a campaign for the entirety of the Nevada family. Here’s what I mean by that:
**No one should have to struggle to find a good-paying job, pay their bills, afford healthcare, or raise a family in our state — but under the Lombardo-Trump economy, Nevadans are _worse off_ than they were years before.**
We need someone in the governor’s office who knows what it’s like to rely on food stamps, WIC, and Medicaid.
We also need someone who won’t turn their backs on working people to please mega corporations and Donald Trump.
I’ve lived through that struggle and know how important it is for people to have a government that truly invests in them — and I promise you, I’ll never forget that.
But we won’t win this race on values alone. The MAGA money machine is already working overtime to protect Governor Joe Lombardo, and the only way we’ll compete with their multi-million dollar war chest is if we band together.
The latest polling shows I’m statistically tied with Lombardo. **This race is winnable, but it can easily slip away from us if we sit back and wait.**
[**So please, make a $5 contribution now, split between Small Town PAC and our campaign, to help us flip Nevada blue:**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=partner-ms-ford-em-small-town-pac.aPk-r1&amount=5&refcode=em20260626-797&t=4&akid=797%2E34582%2EeZ71Ja)

Thanks so much,
Aaron

subject: They’re scared.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

First, the corporate-backed establishment lobbed ugly attacks at Justice
Democrat Darializa Avila Chevalier in the primary for NY-13, falsely
accusing her of lying about her ethnicity. But Darializa beat her 5-term
incumbent anyway.

Then, Super PACs flooded the CO-01 primary race with millions of dollars
against Justice Democrat Melat Kiros, because they’re scared of her
unseating 15-term incumbent Diana DeGette.

Now, pro-DeGette Super PACs are using the same ugly, racist playbook to
attack Melat:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260626-2-mk.UG9fqA&refcode=em20260626-37963&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37963%2E1203867%2E4QYE0h ]Tweet by Andrew Solender: Project 218, super PAC tied to American
Bridge, is out with an ad going negative against Melat Kiros (primary
challenger to Rep. Diana Degette in CO-01): “She’s endorsed by a group
that wants to defund the Denver Police, withdraw from NATO and abolish the
United States Senate.” Screenshot of attack ad that reads “Melat Kiros
just isn’t Denver.”

They attack our candidates and try to divide us because they’re scared.

Scared that this new generation of leaders like Melat will finally deliver
the bold change our working-class communities have long been asking for
and deserve.

Scared that our progressive movement keeps winning elections and building
power in Congress.

Scared that the era of corporations and billionaires buying our elections
is ending.

We’ve proven time and again that organized people beat organized money.
Let’s do it again by electing Melat on Tuesday.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

| | | | | | Three socialists swept NYC's congressional primaries Tuesday night. A 32-year-old took down a 5-term Congressman who chairs the Congressional Hispanic Caucus.
[**The Democratic Party is being remade in real time**](https://us.list-manage.com/Vs1rx_nN4dH?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)**, and most Americans haven't grasped what they just watched.**

| | 🔥 **MAMDANI GOES 3-FOR-3 — THE HOSTILE TAKEOVER IS REAL**
NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's endorsed slate swept three NYC House primaries Tuesday. Some of the leftiest Democrats in Congress just got kicked out by socialists.
We walk through what these three candidates actually believe, and you'll understand why Scott Jennings says this should "frighten all Americans."

🚨 **A BROOKLYN COFFEE SHOP. A JEWISH CONGRESSMAN. THE SILENCE THAT FOLLOWED.**
The weekend before the primary, Dan Goldman walked into a coffee shop in Brooklyn. He was told he wasn't welcome.
He lost his race by roughly 30 points the next week.
Mamdani has said nothing about what's happening to Jewish Democrats in 2026. We have plenty to say.
---

---
| | 🏛️ **NO LIST. NO BALLOTS. NEW MEXICO IN THE CROSSHAIRS.**
The Postmaster General sat in front of the Senate Wednesday. Senator Gary Peters asked him one yes-or-no question about the proposed Trump rule on absentee ballots.
His answer should worry every New Mexican planning to vote by mail in November.
The comment period closes in days. Lawsuits are already moving. We break down what Steiner said, what it means for your ballot, and why the senators from Michigan and New Hampshire weren't satisfied with his answer.

🥇 **HAALAND PICKS HER OWN — MAYOR KEN GETS LOCKED OUT**
After Maggie Toulouse Oliver suspended her lieutenant governor campaign for health reasons, Deb Haaland made a move on the replacement process that has Republicans calling it the Kamala treatment.
Meanwhile, an independent gubernatorial candidate came up short on the 14,200 signatures he needed for the November ballot. We dug into how all 50 states actually pick their lieutenant governors, and you'd be surprised where New Mexico falls.

body:
I’m calling on each of you to respond.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/113644?t=6&akid=25490%2E878179%2ECfLDiQ) Folks, it’s Heather from the Voter Protection Project.

**Pride Month is in full swing. Millions of LGBTQIA+ Americans are celebrating who they are and living as their authentic selves out loud.**

But Trump and his MAGA Republican allies continue to take our fundamental freedoms away. Here are some examples:

1️⃣→ Trump’s hand-picked justices on the Supreme Court **banned gender-affirming care** and **are allowing for civil protections to be taken away** for trans kids and adults.

2️⃣→ They’re **fighting to allow discrimination against the LGBTQIA+ community** and are rebranding June as “**Nuclear Family Month.”**

| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bfd34bb0-bc3a-4907-9d82-5d221288bbe2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Tennessee families deserve to know when a price they're paying isn't actually a "market price" and it's a number quietly calculated by a corporate algorithm designed to extract the most money possible.
**[Chip in today and help us keep fighting for transparency and fairness for every family on our run for Congress!! This is exactly the kind of work this campaign is built on: practical, unglamorous policy that puts working families first. No grandstanding, no shouting matches, just real legislation aimed at protecting your wallet. **We are making headlines by shutting down corruption, not causing it.**

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: I just stepped offstage at the TX Democratic Convention. Here’s what I told the crowd:
body:
I want you to hear this from me.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
I just stepped offstage after delivering my speech at the Texas Democratic Convention.
Before I ask you to **[chip in $5 to power our campaign,](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260626_3_convention.BZ-oib&refcode=em20260626-1433&amount=5&t=1&akid=1433%2E299639%2E1bJ1G5)** I’d like to share with you what I told the crowd:
Onstage just now, I talked about the American Dream.
When I was a little girl growing up in Brownsville, that phrase used to mean something. It meant if you worked hard, you could do more than just survive – you and your family could thrive.
The American Dream was a promise that if you worked a full-time job, you could afford to own a home. Afford to pay your bills. Afford to raise a family, and maybe even take a vacation now and then. And, yes, that you could afford to retire with dignity.
**But under Greg Abbott’s leadership, that dream has slipped away. Our American Dream is out of reach because of the Greg Abbott Corruption Tax.**
Thanks to him, we’re stuck paying more and getting less. Because of Abbott’s no-bid contracts, his school voucher scam, and his giveaways to corporate billionaires and ultra-wealthy friends, WE are stuck paying the price.
And let me be crystal clear: Texans are not asking for handouts. We are asking for what _we already paid for._
This November, we have an opportunity to win a better Texas. One that rewards hard work and puts the American Dream back within our grasp. But we have to vote for it. We have to work for it. And that means doing all we can to build a campaign capable of taking on Greg Abbott and the billionaires.
**[If you’re ready to get to work alongside me, will you pitch in $5 right now? Every single donation — big or small — will go a long way ahead of Tuesday’s deadline.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260626_3_convention.BZ-oib&refcode=em20260626-1433&amount=5&t=2&akid=1433%2E299639%2E1bJ1G5)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260626_3_convention.BZ-oib&amount=5&refcode=em20260626-1433&t=21&akid=1433%2E299639%2E1bJ1G5)
Together, we will win. For our kids. For our community. For Texas.
\- Gina

body:
FBI Fraud Probe of Tony Rodham

[INSIDE JW]

JUDICIAL WATCH SEEKS WARRANT RECORDS OF MICHAEL CAPUTO’S GOOGLE
ACCOUNT

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=38126&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj01V3NKdWI4YTFBcyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=c5473cd7c6b03a0ab3375f9ad95bd9d23b4fba26bb9e5082b4e27135597c1b45]

Americans have a right to know why the Biden Justice Department
secretly authorized the sweeping seizure of Michael Caputo’s entire
Google account just days after President Donald Trump won the 2024
election. We are asking the court to unseal these records so the
American people can finally see the basis for this unprecedented
government intrusion.

Judicial Watch together with Michael Caputo, a longtime ally and
policy advisor to Trump, filed a motion
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=38092&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhcHV0by1tb3Rpb24tdG8tdW5zZWFsLTIzMTUtMDAwOTgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=0a110a1565ee5d6095c1854a7fe4f8e6d816b8cc901771decbf355aaa064f587]
asking the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia to unseal
the search warrant materials related to a November 18, 2024, warrant
that authorized the federal government to seize the entire contents of
Caputo’s Google account (_In the Matter of the Search of Information
Associated with Six Accounts Stored at Premises Controlled by One
Provider Pursuant to 18 U.S.C. § 2703 for Investigation of Violations
of 18 U.S.C. § 951_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=38092&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhcHV0by1tb3Rpb24tdG8tdW5zZWFsLTIzMTUtMDAwOTgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=0a110a1565ee5d6095c1854a7fe4f8e6d816b8cc901771decbf355aaa064f587]
(No. 24-sc-2315)).

Issued shortly after President Donald J. Trump won the November 2024
election, the Biden Justice Department warrant authorized the seizure
of the private content of Caputo’s Google account, along with all
related data, for the period from January 1, 2019, to April 1, 2021.
The seizure was sweeping in scope. It reached every Google platform
Caputo used—email, messaging, voice, and chat—as well as all files
stored in Google Drive and photos; all search, browsing, and location
history; calendar entries, contacts, and documents; advertising and
analytics data; and all associated metadata, including IP addresses,
device identifiers, and timestamps.

On the same day, the court ordered Google not to disclose the
warrant’s existence to Caputo for one year, and sealed the warrant,
application, affidavit, and all related materials. The seal remains in
place.

Caputo was not notified that the government had seized his account
until December 30, 2025—more than a year after the warrant was
issued. Although the warrant was first obtained in November 2024, the
seizure was kept hidden from Caputo and the investigation remained
active through nearly the entire first year of President Trump’s new
administration.

Caputo has never been charged with any crime. (In 2025, Caputo worked
for Ed Martin, then-acting U.S. attorney for the District of
Columbia.)

In its motion
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=38092&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2NhcHV0by1tb3Rpb24tdG8tdW5zZWFsLTIzMTUtMDAwOTgvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=0a110a1565ee5d6095c1854a7fe4f8e6d816b8cc901771decbf355aaa064f587],
Judicial Watch and Caputo state:

> Judicial Watch is investigating the potential politicization of
> numerous federal law enforcement agencies and whether they abused
> their powers to attack an ally of a political opponent.

***

> In the days after the November 2024 election, the United States
> seized [Caputo’s] entire online private life, as reflected in his
> Google account. It did so without his knowledge. ... As the subject
> of the search warrant, whose most private communications, files,
> digital and banking records were seized without his knowledge,
> Caputo’s interest in these records is obvious.

***

> Because no compelling governmental interest justifies continued
> sealing, and because both Caputo, whose entire online private life
> was seized, and Judicial Watch, which seeks to inform the public
> about the weaponization of the federal government against political
> opponents and their allies, have powerful interests in disclosure,
> the Court should unseal these materials.... The historical
> presumption of access to warrant materials vastly outweighs any
> interest the government may have in maintaining the seal.

We also have pending lawsuits for records about spying by the Biden
administration on Caputo and the Trump 2024 presidential campaign. In
June 2025, we sued [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=35990&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbWljaGFlbC1jYXB1dG8vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=d5a78aaacc6dcb10737fc7ef3dcbe4c02809ff2561dabf0b5af87df16fb5a12d] the
U.S. Department of Justice and the Office of the Director of National
Intelligence after the agencies failed to respond adequately to
requests for records regarding the investigation of Caputo
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=35966&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGlua2VkaW4uY29tL2luL21pY2hhZWwtci1jYXB1dG8vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=0a3d0c9431299ea045d5c0c514e66be17d3337a6b090585882f9de62cf164ef0] (_Judicial Watch Inc.
v. U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=35967&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNhcHV0by1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDI2MzEvXV8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=63aef8f6cb171b227ba9a9afeed37813c36033d1ce53fce966d85f0f2eb593e3 _(No.
1:25-cv-02631)), (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=35968&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNhcHV0by1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDE5MDMvXV8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=227900b6880635ba42ffc076d9fb55eda97233f3eaf921b30cfc8d306621aecb _(No.
1:25-cv-01903)), (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. Office of the Director of
National Intelligence_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=35969&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtb2RuaS1jYXB1dG8tY29tcGxhaW50LTAyNDY5L11fP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=ba2a66f883fe5ec0d3aa4eb21082350cc02e6c4354d1747d4144270cbab799d5 _(No.
1:25-cv-02469)).

“In the days after President Trump won reelection, the government
secretly seized my entire online life—my emails, my photos, my
private files, my location, all of it—and didn’t even let Google
tell me it had happened,” Caputo said. “I was never charged with
anything because I did nothing wrong. I have every right to see the
affidavit used to justify this outrageous invasion of my privacy, and
so does the public. I’m grateful to Judicial Watch for fighting to
drag this into the light.”

The Biden administration’s secret seizure of Trump friend Michael
Caputo’s entire digital life after the 2024 election is a stunning
abuse of power and yet another example of the weaponization of federal
law enforcement against President Trump and his allies. The Biden
administration raided a private citizen’s online life, forced Google
to hide it from him for a year, charged him with nothing, and is still
concealing the basis for it behind a court seal. Astonishingly, this
secret surveillance was kept hidden from him through nearly the entire
first year of President Trump’s new administration. The American
people have a right to know who authorized this assault and why.”

Caputo is a political consultant and former assistant secretary for
public affairs at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.
The unsealing of these materials is one piece of our broader
investigation into whether federal law enforcement agencies abused
their powers to target the allies of a political opponent. If the
court unseals the materials, We will obtain, analyze, and make them
available to the public.

We have taken a leading role in exposing the politicization and
weaponization of federal law enforcement. We previously moved to
unseal
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=27830&F=T&&hash=1403a0b3312523bd4a3e190ab53e1bdbb7d698cf7d2e98f2910a108b8b07019b]
the search warrant materials used in the FBI’s August 2022 raid on
Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home and to publish
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=83756&L=38095&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkaWNpYWwtd2F0Y2gtYXNrcy1jb3VydC1mb3ItY2FydGVyLXBhZ2UtZmlzYS13YXJyYW50LWhlYXJpbmctdHJhbnNjcmlwdHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=8a66a48f3c2ed269275caead9d8ddeb70c7f28a7f106c4c8ab2137b6cc86e21e]
the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court transcripts relating to
the surveillance of former Trump campaign advisor Carter Page.

We are currently pursuing multiple Freedom of Information Act (FOIA)
lawsuits for records about the investigations of other Trump allies.

In April 2026, we sued

Thanks to all the readers who wrote in with their choice for the most essential American song. Many voted for _The Star-Spangled Banner_ , but a lot of you also noted that we left out an obvious choice: _God Bless America_ , and we have to agree with you. ## Bolton Pleads Guilty in Docs Case
Former National Security Adviser John Bolton [pleaded guilty Friday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHumzAQx_GnMZsjc9i4GTxUqtjSpao6ogOfw0XGRthNyttXJI_wn086_T7fP7fxhhw53X_iSq6GPCZ6lUi10j5OOdactkjoy_0vx3oshPWFzxEU9FL1EuzokeMx6sa7QATUNeRa-w2MMUqZZnEqoEZoAU1ozTRdW62NBmPQTlZpoxp25zfVg21Vq1R3MVdlKaA31vSTRiO0Is8175dH5lQXCvHIT9ovc16b6JZatyK67wIGAQNO8yk4bwKG378EDI-8JPmxSPq30VzJy7dKflRy5bJg8mcHOUcshQOTl5xC3lesnJOAodS8H6Ib2IvuR9tpAN0p0-zOby-OkUtvhVb3FTm-l9Uv5Xw6-B8AAP__63qKMQ) to one felony count of illegally retaining classified national security information, resolving an 18-count federal indictment. Bolton entered the plea in federal court in Greenbelt, Maryland. Under the deal, he agreed to forfeit approximately $2.2 million, serve 100 hours of community service, and [give up his federal retirement pay](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOgzAQBNCvgc7IOBiTwsU1dLn2SmTsddhosRHehOTvT7l8wtUjjebNz2W6OCRM12-3guWYpwRHIWCGfZozcU4bgQvlekfi1wKOD_eYlFS9kL1QZgoO6TV1dbARQMGpBtuaQWmtpdT1Yo0OoGaloxz0oH3ngjzPulVGRzmfXV-jfbfJXplWtlKeGn2WBqIL2uh-7pyuOgkBOe_NLWPiBSK98gP2xue1Jrswb6U6fVVqrNR4HEcT8_OteOeVGrdMyOhLpUZ4Ct7v6yZyjOjRkbjlJYmPU3yg4iMVrWgH4fM9cRGeXCkYEYII2ReBKaDnFRLXuw3bgURYelN18ro6pL9h_K83H1b9BgAA___mBIym). Prosecutors agreed to recommend no more than five years in prison. Sentencing is set for [Oct. 28](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGuqzAMBuCnCVtQagihQ4a7sJ273hEFYsBVSKrELeLtr2gf4WyWLVn_9__7GX8cBYrrX7ej5SWNEY8SkBnzOKXAKT4DOl_WFwU-N3R8uPcICjqpOglm9I7CObaVtwsiYFOhvZketNZK6WqzLfZ3gBnVvW-9cV3jOzP1BnBB8Brniuz1TXVgbuqmVFPruzK4OK-N7qbWadEq9MQp149EkTdcwpnemOs57VWwG_OziOaPgEHAcBxHPU_lUlx3AcM1ChgeaYvyK5JfjLxkMiM7ihRXOQdXCi2EXkbHlKILsuD8ysSnpLikvH_WAoYqW_88KAQqnRGtWndH4ZOHf1Xi28L_AAAA__-2bIpC). Bolton served as President Trump's national security adviser from 2018 to 2019.
## Ukraine Slams Russia with Drones
Ukraine launched [one of its largest drone assaults](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M3q2zAQBPCnkW8K8urLOehQKIYe_r32aNbR2larSEHaJOTti_sKPQ_8mJlfX8sXppzK_hPvFHirS6F3z8RMbVlr5loemTD2_Zkyfw5CfuNrAQVOKifBLxFT_ixmiGEjAtIDhdFPYK1Vyg5H0M6rSUc0UU03N5lxJUMWVm82M60ahhROTTnwoxqV0hd7VZ42jNZbtxq0wiiKiWu7_K6p8EFb_tQXtcut3occDuZHF_qbgFnAjOvtXHBmAuYfhakV5FQLZgHz80_DVEgytp24y_bsPaF0TsnYaqEuT7ik_WB5r_1W3wLmzrV9hJ5TFPr7qA1ouF7V0EJ8vFPOqTsvjNrvmPK_SvxfP74C_A0AAP__VcSHnw) of the war overnight, with Russia's Defense Ministry claiming 660 drones targeted at least 12 regions, including Moscow and occupied Crimea. Ukrainian forces also struck two military vessels and air defense systems in Crimea's Kerch region, where authorities declared a state of emergency and [halted all civilian fuel sales](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAYhJ8GOwwi6FpQXGO3115pfuF35UQwgEu8p794r3DdJJOZzHxfz-kJ1ln_-oQdVV7C5LEkhzljnObgcvCHQzDpdVqXrxUhF3hPnPGOso7yfjJg3TWJyqgFkWNboWr6B5dSMiarVTWtGAYhUA_8IbVe-rYFgchmyWXTPubKqruNdbxvWMNYW8uB9biAkb3sZgGSCIbG5hDr72B9XnFxV3hjrHXYK6fWnI9E2g_CR8LHUkqt53S_uH3Cx1sSPp5bBOuRxjMlC7RApCYGjxRyBr1RHe2OQDeMeqU_6NCn7broEqJGepzZeore3DnCxyoqcxTrnE1dTwR77WDd3578L4hvxX8DAAD__7hxiOs). The barrage followed President Zelenskyy's announcement of a "40-day influence operation" aimed at compelling Russia to end the war. Ukraine has already launched more than 3,000 long-range drones into Russia this year, compared to 110 in all of 2024.
## Major Heat Wave to Hit US
The first widespread significant heat wave of 2026 is about to hit the U.S., caused by two heat domes that [will soon merge](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDEP2yAUhH8N3oieMZhkYOjiLV07Ws_mYaiwieAlVv595fYndLw76XTf_XrOT0w5HdtP3MlxKPNBZ8vETHVeSuZyvDKhb9s7Zf5GQj7xMytQo4RRKjt7TPk76867QKRo6Mj19q6MMQCmiy6Yu_EYrAZt-4BotDWAAcGsMFigLrmrDUZle-gBhpt5gKWA3lgzLhqN0EA-cam33yUdHCnkb_lQva1l77KLzK8mhh9CTUJNHCmmnK9MqCmWnS4goabGyCRP5DUKNZmH7hXcpS_vJZO8uKQvO8m17OnYJBf5bjJSpSbPSIdMnLNsjJUvXemfsZA8S20s1NRV519nyjm10QoN247p74yO_-vXj1N_AgAA__9E2Y48) into one massive high-pressure system over the South and Midwest. The heat begins this weekend along the Gulf Coast and expands north through the week, with the dome centering over St. Louis by July 1 and Chicago by the Fourth of July. [Here are maps of what's expected.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGypCAURL8GMyy8Co4BwSRmsxtuaKFclVkEC-4MO3-_5av3By89XdXVp_88podx3oXtlzlQ0xqngCV7JMI0zdFTDKdHY_P2cp4-Oxoq5j2BAMWF4tBP1jj_mbrK6hURsK1QN_0NpJRCyGrXLah5WMDKpV0s4G0Z7K0zLXRqHsDapnL6ahMK-kY0QrS1HESPq7Gyl2rujGSdQOsopvoZXaAdV_-Jb0z1Eo_K653ozKy9MxgZjKWU-sjhyhiMGPgrXxQN7ZgYjBTPTDE5vDCVyC8lbuOBmS_xmF1ATpGvMR18dht_Zf4tjTzgP-IF8S-D0SR-v4Oi309TJW3P4rx3WfWsE9thnP8aRz969K3hfwAAAP__lUSMog) Heat index values could reach 100 to 110 across much of the region, with parts of the Mississippi Valley peaking near 115. The heatwave is likely to last all week long, and perhaps into the weekend in the Southeast.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/61a4fd50-36c9-44e0-9795-eebb48816bec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
On Tuesday night, three candidates the Democratic establishment did not want in Congress won their primaries in New York. Mamdani-backed Brad Lander beat two-term Representative Dan Goldman in the 10th District. Darializa Avila Chevalier beat five-term Representative Adriano Espaillat in the 13th. Claire Valdez won the open 7th. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries [campaigned against all three and lost](https://substack.com/redirect/e184c832-8bdb-4b99-a31a-8ec248bab044?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Governor Kathy Hochul backed the incumbents and lost too. Mamdani framed the night as a referendum on whether the current leadership serves the people, and said the goal was [electing "better Democrats"](https://substack.com/redirect/b23584eb-60a9-48aa-8b5c-be2085293db4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Democratic establishment did not take the night well.
* * *
By Wednesday morning social media was full of posts from Democrats losing their collective minds over what the wins meant for the party. Representative Josh Gottheimer of New Jersey, a moderate, warned against letting the socialists take over the party and put it plainly. "If you're a socialist, you're not a Democrat." Representative Greg Meeks, a New York Democrat close to Jeffries, called it a bad night for the city and pointed to a winner's deleted posts about abolishing police and prisons. Representative Tom Suozzi compared the DSA to MAGA.
[Subscribe](https://substack..CCxkPnOuEEy0QuJGytHhRIAdBXzMfufZ55LkxFCIuKo?)
The pundits followed suit. One outlet warned Mamdani's endorsements put the party at risk in November. An opinion piece argued New York Democrats had hobbled the party for years to come.
But, in likely the most significant post about the fallout on social media, former chair of the Democratic National Committee, Jaime Harrison, who ran the party during the Biden administration, added fuel to the fire. "If you hate the Democratic Party, then please don't run for our nomination."
Jaime's statement is a microcosm of a larger cultural and branding problem Democrats are now finding is both out of step with where the country is, and has fractured its long-suffering base.
* * *
### **Cultural Rot**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6147e9b4-e8ca-432e-a0c2-946e455752a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I invite readers to count the possessives in Jaime's post. "Our nomination," "Our resources," "Our volunteers," "Our infrastructure." It seems like Jaime thinks the party belongs to someone in that sentence, and that someone is not the people who voted on Tuesday.
Harrison knows about resources. He raised a record $109 million dollars for his own Senate race in 2020 and lost to Lindsey Graham by ten points. He did not tell anyone that those "resources" are not available to every Democrat.
Sara McGee, Democratic nominee for the Texas state legislature, house district 132, wrote a scathing rebuke of Jaime's commentary. [It's also one this author knows and understands because she has run for office without the support of the Democratic Party. ](https://open.substack.com/pub/whispercampaign/p/12k-versus-1m?utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f41603b-4566-472e-a71f-bb7adc0e73ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ask Democratic candidates who run down ballot. They consistently report almost no direct help from the party. In Georgia last year, state House candidate Michelle Kang lost after her own volunteers left her to attend a Kamala Harris rally. "We feel like we were left behind by the presidential election," she told NOTUS. Over the last decade, the Republican committee that funds statehouse races outraised its Democratic counterpart by more than 100 million dollars. The volunteers and the infrastructure Harrison talks about do not reach most of the people running under the party's name.
Senator Chris Murphy, always astute and more often than not right, replied to Harrison and asked the only question that matters. "Who is the Democratic Party if it is not the voters?" He added that voters choose candidates, party leaders do not, and that the voters are asking for a bolder party.
Murphy's was the courteous version. Progressives dragged Harrison across the platform and reminded him of his record. Briahna Joy Gray, who hosts Bad Faith, said he was publicly threatening the few people the party has going for it. Jezebel was blunter, reading the post as a leadership scolding routine from a man who set fundraising records but somehow still lost to Lindsey Graham.
[Subscribe](https://substack..CCxkPnOuEEy0QuJGytHhRIAdBXzMfufZ55LkxFCIuKo?)
Establishment Democrats have long believed the party is an institution with owners who bestow the right for people to belong to it. The statement Harrison made is decidedly decisive, meant to pit "good democrats," against "problematic democrats." Both groups are _DEMOCRATS_. This is toxic culture talking, and the reflex is rot and protection of entrenched power. There is a second form of rot that has hold of the party: performative politics to monopolize absolute control.
* * *
### Central Branding
Right now, you can't buy campaign support if from the Party if you're a candidate who isn't a middle-aged white man with facial hair and a job tied to a hat. Veteran, cop, soldier, firefighter, ironworker, coal miner, or generic Everyman. A trade in the biography, or a uniform in the past, or both. A name nobody has to learn to pronounce. Meet those marks and the party has a role for you. The party will fund you, brand you, and run you as the answer to a question the they spent a decade getting wrong: losing working men to Trump.
The consultant class that runs the party's election has decided that the party got too coastal, too credentialed, and too feminine. The cure they are prescribing is a man who looks like a Steelworker for Obama poster from 2008. Find him. Style him. Hand him a populist script and a flag pin. Run him in district after district as proof the party remembers where it came from.
The Washington Post has a name for this product. It calls them "rugged guy" campaigns. The persona library for Democratic candidates in 2026 is short.
1. **The Working-Class Hero,** white male, union card, trade, hat.
2. **The Statesman,** white male, older, never raises his voice.
3. **The Veteran** , white male (or female) service record on the first slide.
4. **The Pragmatist** , white male, suburban, educated, moderate by design.
5. **The Insurgent,** young white male (or female), with the right connections.

Three of the five of these personas are meant to be white men. The other two makes room for a woman (the Insurgent, the Veteran) only when consultants find she has independently amassed a movement large enough to override the defaults.
[Subscribe](https://substack..CCxkPnOuEEy0QuJGytHhRIAdBXzMfufZ55LkxFCIuKo?)
### The Manufactured Man
Graham Platner is the party's showcase model. He won the Maine Senate primary on June 9 with 72 percent of the vote and faces Susan Collins in November. He is the oyster farmer, the Marine, the harbormaster who rails against the establishment and the donor class.
He also told a volunteer training in February, in a recording the Portland Press Herald obtained, "This is not a campaign that's run by consultants." The same reporting shows his campaign paid 2.2 million dollars to a D.C. digital firm and tens of thousands more to D.C. communications consultants. Two national advisers, Joe Calvello and Morris Katz, were instrumental in recruiting him to run and in launching his campaign with a viral video. Calvello had worked for John Fetterman and for Mamdani. Katz runs out of New York for a firm called the Fight Agency.
I am not writing about Platner's character (I did write about where he came from and who he is in a [previous issue](https://substack.com/redirect/04ebef64-9a19-480c-b07e-cc99bd043d2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), but it's important for voters to understand about who sought him (and candidates like him) out and why.
But, a casting call this specific is also a rejection letter for other candidates from communities that depend on Democrats to advocate for their rights.
Jasmine Crockett lost the Texas Senate primary to James Talarico. In June she said she had no plans to actively campaign for him. The backlash was immediate. A professor called her petty. Other posts called her bitter and selfish.
The unity rule only runs in one direction. When the man in a hat loses, the party protects his brand and waits for his comeback. When the Black woman or the Latina loses, the party tells her the loss was a verdict on her attitude.
### What the Numbers Say
Voters have been telling the party what the issues are for a long time. The party has not listened.
In April, Pew found 59 percent of Americans hold an unfavorable view of the Democratic Party, a number near the party's recent lows. Congressional Democrats polled worse. An Economist and YouGov survey in January put them at 29 percent favorable and 62 percent unfavorable, below congressional Republicans and below Donald Trump.
The complaint is consistent. When CNN asked voters who dislike both parties what bothers them about Democrats, the top answers were that the party does nothing and will not fight. A Strength in Numbers poll found the loudest Democratic complaint about Democrats is weakness, a leadership that will not stand up to Trump.
A Democratic firm, Impact Research, polled the battleground House districts that will decide control of the chamber. In those districts, voters called the Democratic Party more corrupt than the Republican Party, 49 to 44, in the middle of a Republican corruption wave. The pollster works for Democrats. The watchdog that commissioned the poll, End Citizens United, works to elect them.
Voters already know how the game is rigged. They think the party is corrupt. They think it will not fight for them. The party's answer, manufacturing authenticity to appeal to MAGA men and policing who gets to run, is baffling in light of those insights.
### Why Democrats are Failing
It seems that Democrats no longer believe they need to commit to good policy. As such, there is a slew of policies the base wants they will likely fail to deliver, unless candidates like those who won in New York on Tuesday are in a political position to push them. But, the Democratic Party, seeing these wins and attempting to sell voters a knock-off product, doesn't realize authenticity is something consultants cannot manufacture. People want authentic candidates because they are tired of being marks in corruption sanctioned by Democrats in power. Thanks to Trump, voters are more likely to smell the difference.
The party can recruit Temu versions of Graham Platner and write them a populist script and run him in district after district. What the party cannot do is manufacture the thing that made Tuesday happen. The candidates who won in New York were not packaged by the party. They ran against it. They told voters what they believed, and enough voters believed in them. The Tuesday turnout was a fraction of last year's mayoral race, and establishment Democrats still lost because voters were are unmoved by the establishment's brand. They know they are being screwed, the party is rigged, and they are, rightfully, fed up with it.
A party that manufactures authenticity for a living will always fear a candidate who simply _has_ it because that candidate is a direct threat to the corruption and power party insiders have held onto for decades. That fear comes through clearly in Harrison's post. Not that the winners hate the party. That the winners did not need, and will not be beholden to, the Democratic machine.
* * *
_Laura Rodriguez-Carbone served the public for twenty-three years across seven federal agencies before being purged from federal service in 2025. She ran for Congress in Ohio 's 7th District in 2026. She writes The Whisper Campaign and co-founded The Angry Democrat._

clean_body: We have no other choice than to fight back. The most extreme legislation in years. June 2026: A personal note from Gabby Giffords to you. Please don’t skip this message. Today is Friday, June 26, and Donald Trump just announced that his administration is working to pass a nationwide concealed carry mandate. Let me be clear: A national concealed carry mandate will make all of us less safe. Violent crime rates rose up to 15% in states that weakened their standards for concealed carry. Police officers have already warned that these laws make their jobs nearly impossible, but the gun industry doesn’t care...as long as they can profit and sell more guns. This is the most extreme legislation in years — and now that it has Trump’s backing, there’s a real chance it could pass. We must fight back. This bill could come down to just a handful of votes. GIFFORDS is working tirelessly to mobilize our supporters, but we can’t do it alone. Any contribution goes a long way. Thank you.
